data.perturbation_content: Initial assumption of a single attacker is wrong. Forensic timeline analysis confirms TWO INDEPENDENT threat actors: (1) a financially-motivated ransomware affiliate (generic cybercrime), and (2) APT41/Winnti conducting targeted IP theft of pharmaceutical research data. They are not coordinating — this is coincidental dual compromise through the same vulnerability.
